name: Patenli Ayakkabilar
description: E-commerce platform for roller shoes (tekerlekli ve ışıklı ayakkabı). Search products, inspect specifications, check stock and view sizing guides.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search active roller shoes and wheeled sneakers by keyword, category, gender or price.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get complete product details including price, sizes, colors, LED charging, wheels, and stock status.

tools.name: get_sizing_guide
tools.description: Get sizing recommendation for roller shoes based on foot length in cm.

tools.name: get_shipping_and_returns
tools.description: Get shipping duration, shipping cost and 14-day free return policy details.
